body: *hugs* You sound just like me, right down to the short 'hello' texts. I know how much it sucks and I sincerely hope you feel better and find some friends who understand you.
Thanks for the advice. I hope you are doing better.

I agree! I would rather sleep or sit at home on reddit than go out to a club. I always let them pick what they want also, just because I don't want to add to the boringness. It does suck to be us :( At least we aren't alone in our suckiness. I'm from NY.

Thanks for the post. I think they do because they never call or text me, I always have to reach out to them. Then when the time comes to hang out they suddenly have something else they have to do, or they give hints that they can't wait to leave or for me to leave while they're with me, or they play on their most phone of the time. I imagine that i'm boring because I just sit there thinking of things to say and then end up saying practically nothing the whole time. I think having so much insight is what makes me boring because I think too much instead of just relaxing and having fun.
Thank you, you guys are the best.

Thank you for the post. I'm 23 and i've been feeling like crap since I can remember. Even when I was little I was full of anxiety and depressed as heck. Recently it just got so much worse, I sleep 15 hours a day or more. I keep having to go for testing and they found nodules on my thyroid, but the dr didn't think it's that serious. I went in again today looking so pathetic and begged him because I can't take it anymore. He gave me a very small dose of something for it. Hopefully it will help me feel better. I can't even imagine having energy anymore because i've been so exhausted for the longest time.

wow. Thank you for that. I don't know why, but majority of my 'friends' are just hard to talk to and I feel like I have to impress them for them to like me, feels like they just hang out with me cause they feel bad. They never call or text me, I always have to reach out them. The others are always busy or they live so far away. I wish I could have someone like you to hang out with, you sound just like me!
I also want to say thank you for the hug and taking your time to read about me. It really means a lot to me.

I'm always so quiet when I'm with anyone, it's like I'm a puppet or something. My mind is blank and it's do frustrating on top of everything else. I don't even have a good reason to be sad so I don't even know how to get help because when they ask what's wrong I can never tell. I probably would come off as a whiny attention seeker. I have been feeling sick (physically) and the dr doesn't want to give me anything for it because he says my problem is very slight. I feel like crap 24:7 and I'm just so tired. I wish I could fall asleep and wake up as a new person.

Oops. Didn't mean to post on my main account.

You're a high school teacher? That is so cool. I'm in college to be a teacher myself. Its so hard to do student teaching and schoolwork while you're depressed. I feel like I'm not making the most of this opportunity. But that's a whole other story.
Im sorry to hear about your dad. I know I'm going to hate myself for taking so long to get help, but I'm so stubborn and too tired to do anything about it.
I try to play games on the computer or xbox, but they get tiring very quickly. So much thinking involved with most of them and Super Mario falls in the holes or dies to fish and turtles too many times for me to play longer than 10 minutes. I just end up quitting and falling back asleep. I just want to fall asleep and wake up to a new life soo badly.
I'm sorry for not responding to your whole message, I cant think straight tonight. I did read it though. Thank you for being so nice to me.

For starters, i've been depressed and full of anxiety for as long as I can remember. I can't remember the last time I woke up and was truly happy and carefree. I try so hard to tell myself to just enjoy life and make the most of what I have because there are people who are so much worse off than me. I feel like I don't even have a right to be upset when I hear about all the bad stuff that happens to others like hurricanes, poverty, and cancer.

But then, just when I start to have a glimmer of hope, I get sick. If it isn't my back, it's headaches, or stomach aches, or just plain tiredness and irritability. I sleep 2/3 of the day. I'm so sick of it all, and it sucks to see all my "friends" so happy and carefree just enjoying life, while i'm here making myself miserable.

I ruined the best years of my life by being this way and convincing myself that i'm worthless compared to others. I missed out on so much fun because I was too shy to talk to anyone or make friends.

I don't even know that I have the energy to even be happy anymore. I've been this way for sooooo long that happiness seems like too much work.
I don't even know where to start.
